Convert a spatial nitrogen array to a total biomass time series

calculate_biomass.Rd

Multiplies nitrogen concentration (mg N/m\(^3\)) by cell volume (m\(^3\)) and applies \(5.7 \times 20 / 10^9\) to convert to tonnes wet weight. For 3-D groups (vertebrates, plankton) the full volume array is used; for 2-D benthic groups layer 7 volumes serve as a proxy for cell area (layer 7 is 1 m deep, so volume \(\approx\) area).

Usage

calculate_biomass(biomass_array, fg.file, name, outputs.nc)

Arguments

biomass_array

Numeric array from ncdf4::ncvar_get() for a _N variable. Either 3-D (boxes x layers x time) or 2-D (boxes x time).

fg.file

Data frame of functional group metadata (output of process_fg).

name

Character. Variable name (e.g. "CHY_N").

outputs.nc

An open ncdf4 connection to the main output file, used to read the volume variable.

Value

Numeric vector of total biomass in tonnes wet weight, one value per time step.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  outputs.nc <- open_main_nc(path = "path/to/atlantis/outputs", prefix = "AMPS")
  fg <- process_fg("PugetSoundAtlantisFunctionalGroups.csv")
  biomass <- calculate_biomass(ncdf4::ncvar_get(outputs.nc, "CHY_N"),
                               fg.file = fg, name = "CHY_N",
                               outputs.nc = outputs.nc)
} # }
